services.story: The main story: an on-site class for 9 staff at Alex's office, $85 a student ($765), nothing taken to book; the bill comes after the class for the final count (at least 6 students, $510).

services.name: Family class at home
services.story: A family or babysitter class at home for up to 4 people, $300, paid in full when booking.

services_shape: class: seats in a scheduled class at the training center, each student with their own seat, their own result and their own completion card; a private class books one instructor for a group, at the center or at the customer's place (flow B)
questions_before_times: which course, and if it's for a job or a board (some accept only certain programs)
a new card or a renewal (a renewal brings a current card that's still in date)
how many students, for a group or an on-site class
for a blended course: is the online part done
safety_stop: someone collapsed or not breathing right now, choking, chest pain, a stroke sign
first_steps: On-site class: the final student list
license: none from the state for teaching CPR and first aid in most places; each instructor holds a current instructor card from a nationally recognized program (the program's own card, which the business shows as its word); where a state agency approves providers for some uses (child care staff, school staff), the business shows only the approvals it really holds
staff_skills: courses each instructor may teach, languages, teaching minors, on-site travel
messages_never: test results (passed or not), health or physical limits, dates of birth: only on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
